title: Record the bit-0 census false prune on 01021323
body:
## Summary
- The pinned #2542 length-18 census groups prefix states by bit 0 and prunes them with the balanced weight-parity budget. On the universal word `01021323` the weight walk stays at collision count 0, while the bit-0 walk reaches 8 and crosses budget 5.
- The same rule rejects 6 of the 22 simple canonical universal words at four labels and length 8. The two three-label domains have no such simple false prune.
- No seven-label census, no `f(7)` decision, and no selected-frontier change.

## Test plan
